title: an AI reads every reported item first, and a person makes the call

criteria.text: Every report and every poster rebuttal triggers one read, after the report is stored; the report never waits
criteria.note: `assessAfterReport` via `after()` from `create.ts:466`; rebuttal from `report-actions.ts:72`; Page photo, Page picture, Post words and post photo are read (PRs #495, #513). Builders' reports are skipped by design [V] Checked: unmarked: `create.test.ts:519`, `answer-actions.test.ts` (only partial markers).

criteria.text: Haiku with text and vision, structured: category, severity 1–4, confidence, outcome, reason ≤ 140
criteria.note: `assess.ts` (Haiku 4.5, forced tool, zod, reason cut to 140; eight categories incl. child and other) [V] Checked: no (partial marker `assess.test.ts:25`).

criteria.text: Under 0.70 Sonnet gives a second opinion; both stored, second shown
Send only content, reporter's reason, rebuttal; no name, handle or email; rules versioned
criteria.note: Payload built in `assess.ts` from `AssessInput`, photo as bytes; `RULES_VERSION` in the system prompt [V] Checked: yes, weak (asserts no "@" and one id absent; `assess.test.ts:75`).

criteria.text: Each assessment stores model, prompt version, category, severity, confidence, outcome, reason, latency, time; RLS on, no policies
criteria.note: `report_assessments` (migration 20261007260000) has every column plus tokens and a skipped reason; RLS on, no policy [V] Checked: unmarked: `tests/report-assessments-db.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Shadow mode: an assessment changes nothing (but F102's severity-4 auto-restore)
criteria.note: Only `report_assessments` written in `runAssessment`; restore step is the ruled exception [V] Checked: yes, one path (`run-assessment.test.ts:91`); queue order and notify not asserted.

criteria.text: A person's decision is logged against the AI suggestion
Live mode is a data switch; live raises severity and order; remove, restore, strikes stay a person's
criteria.note: `moderation_settings.ai_mode`, `fetchAiMode`; higher of the two severities in live (PR #513) [V] Checked: unmarked: `ReviewQueue.test.tsx:390` (marked F101.3); `fetchAiMode` untested.

criteria.text: Harness prints recall, false alarms, severity accuracy, latency, cost; runs on every prompt change
criteria.note: `npm run moderation:eval` prints all of them [V]; nothing runs it on a prompt change (no moderation job in `.github`). #638 Checked: unmarked: `eval-metrics.test.ts`, `eval-run.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Builder-built labelled set; licensed photos, licence per photo; children and adult cases handled safely
criteria.note: 17 cases, 6 synthetic pictures with licence records, `validateSet` refuses unlicensed or minor or sexual images [V]. No real stock photo, no children-rule case, no adult case, 8 violating cases. #639 Checked: yes, for the validator (`eval-cases.test.ts`, 3 markers).

criteria.text: Live needs ≥ 95% recall, 100% severity-1, < 10% false alarms, plus two weeks of shadow the PM read
criteria.note: `meetsLiveTargets` exists; nothing ties the flip to it; set too small; no shadow-read place. Scenario Size puts live after beta. #640 Checked: no (partial marker `eval-metrics.test.ts:44`).

criteria.text: Suspected severity-1 never sent to a provider; images hash-checked; row goes to a person with the result
criteria.note: Skip half built: a `sensitive_content` report gets a skipped row, no call, no image fetch [V]. Hash check (Cloudflare CSAM tool) not built; build log says rows go to a person without a hash result. #641 Checked: yes for the skip half (`run-assessment.test.ts:50`); no standing guard that no other path calls the provider (#643).
